rationale: The core dispute remains unresolved: labor and the state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist on footprint reduction unless proven otherwise. Round 3 mostly repeated hardened positions, but both sides now agreed on the need for quantified plant-by-plant analysis, so the dialogue is not fully deadlocked yet—rather it is circling around an evidentiary test that has not been completed.
